d.ko: Enishia is a simple nun and the sole manager of the last church in Megista. However, she must pay off a mountain of debt to prevent the demolition of the church and its attached orphanage. How can she make the money she needs?

d.zh: 艾妮希雅是一名单纯的修女，也是旧都美吉斯塔最后一座教堂的唯一管理者。但是，她现在必须偿还巨额的借贷来保护教堂和附属孤儿院不被拆除。她该如何赚到这笔天文数字呢？
